name: m4_sediment
_doc: M4 gate — suspended sediment. V5 still-water settling column: a Gaussian sand slab settles at Soulsby w_s (d50=0.2 mm, 10 C seawater) as plug flow, then deposits via the flux BC D=w_s*c_b; gate = L2(num vs exact translate) < 2% and sand-mass (susp+bed) error < 0.1%. V6 equilibrium Rouse profile (research/11 §7): periodic channel h=0.4 m, u*=0.02 m/s, d50=0.1 mm at 20 C reference (nu=1.05e-6, rho=1025) => R=w_s/(beta*kappa*u*)=0.91; eddy diffusivity eps_s=beta*kappa*u*z(1-z/h) with beta=1 (Rouse analytic; production suspended diffusion uses sigma_s=0.7). c Dirichlet-pinned to c_a at a=0.05h (permitted in THIS validation only; production bed exchange stays flux-based). Gate = fitted Rouse exponent within 15% of R.
